items.title: The first Chern class is central and commutes with bivariant classes

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the first Chern class is central in the bivariant theory and commutes with arbitrary bivariant classes (statement lines 6331-6342, tag 0B71-adjacent). The proof reduces centrality to commutation, expresses the pullback of the cap with the first Chern class through the zero section of the associated line bundle, moves the bivariant class through the flat pullback and the pushforward by the bivariant axioms, and concludes by injectivity of the pullback along the bundle. That computation is the substance, so the claim is H2.
